name: nanobot v0.3 Always-On Personal AI Agent
description: Lightweight AI agent that lives in your chat apps and runs 24/7.

PORT.description: Port of the WebUI/WebSocket channel. Railway's healthcheck and public domain use it; keep 8765 unless you also change the domain's target port.

NANOBOT_WEB_TOKEN.description: WebUI password (upstream tokenIssueSecret), generated at deploy. Copy it from this variable and paste it on the WebUI login screen.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenRouter key (openrouter.ai/keys): one key for Claude, GPT, Gemini and many more. You can also add any provider later in WebUI Settings > Models.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic API key. nanobot's stock default model (anthropic/claude-opus-4-5) runs on this key without further model setup.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI API key. Also set LLM_MODEL (e.g. an OpenAI model ID) or pick a model in the WebUI.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Google Gemini API key. Also set LLM_MODEL or pick a model in the WebUI.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Optional. DeepSeek API key. Also set LLM_MODEL or pick a model in the WebUI.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: Optional. Groq API key (chat models and the default voice-message transcription provider).

LLM_MODEL.description: Optional. Model ID as your provider names it (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-4.5 on OpenRouter). When set it wins over the WebUI model on every restart; leave empty to choose in the WebUI.

LLM_PROVIDER.description: Optional. Provider for LLM_MODEL (openrouter, anthropic, openai, gemini, deepseek, groq). Empty = auto-detect from the model ID and available keys.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather; enables the Telegram channel. Channels can also be added later in WebUI Settings > Channels.

TELEGRAM_ALLOW_FROM.description: Optional. Comma-separated Telegram user IDs that may talk to the bot. Empty = unknown users get a pairing code you approve in the WebUI.

DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Discord bot token (Developer Portal > Bot, enable Message Content intent); enables the Discord channel.

DISCORD_ALLOW_FROM.description: Optional. Comma-separated Discord user IDs allowed to talk to the bot. Empty = pairing codes.

SLACK_BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional. Slack bot token (xoxb-...). Needs SLACK_APP_TOKEN too (Socket Mode, no public webhook needed).

SLACK_APP_TOKEN.description: Optional. Slack app-level token (xapp-...) with connections:write, for Socket Mode.

SLACK_ALLOW_FROM.description: Optional. Comma-separated Slack member IDs allowed to DM the bot. Empty = DM pairing codes.

TZ.description: IANA timezone the agent uses for dates, reminders and cron jobs (e.g. Europe/Istanbul).

WEBUI_ALLOW_REMOTE_INSTALL.description: true lets authenticated WebUI users install extra Python packages and marketplace skills. Common chat channels are preinstalled, so keep false unless you need more.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds the old container gets to finish running turns and flush session files before a redeploy stops it.
